coaching.headline: Down 1-4 at their Fangtooth by minute 7 with three lane reads against us — and we flipped it on three big fight wins: 3-0, 4-0, 5-1.
coaching.team: The early game was theirs (Fangtooth 8 and 15, a 0-3 bad trade at 2.7 chasing Skylar with no objective up), and carry, mid and jungle all read behind. The comeback was structural: from 19 minutes we took Mini Prime, Fangtooth, both Genesis spawns and both Primals, and the fights swung big — 3-0 at our Fangtooth at 20.5, 4-0 at their Orb at 25.4, 5-1 at our inhibitor at 32.7. Two things to trim: three of six won fights went uncashed, and the 21.4 bad trade (0-3 in our half) plus two fights opened with bodies already down (22.4, 23.1) kept the door open longer than needed.
coaching.whatShiftedIt: The 20.5-minute 3-0 at our Fangtooth ended their momentum, and the 25.4 4-0 at their Orb Prime rolled straight into our Primal Fangtooth at 27 — making the 32.7 closing fight a formality.

perPlayer.7c8ab99c-31c5-4ea5-a6fa-e0d6417c3f1b: Legion's lane read Skylar's all game (he finished 14/5) and the 10.4 catch by Dekker made it harder — but 8/5 with 10.3k objective damage out of a losing read is the profitable version of a bad lane. The 21.7 death preceded their inner tower at 23.1, and Vanquisher was the missing core piece; both are cheap fixes on a winning formula.
perPlayer.16f28434-561f-4f23-9454-40321f4a1ef3: Steel's 21 wards and the late-game frontline made the flip possible — the support lane was our only read that went from even to ours, and the 25.4 and 32.7 wins had Steel anchoring both. The cost side: 6 deaths, and the film prices three of them (6.6 before their Fangtooth, 18.2 before a tower, 24.4 before their Orb). Fewer solo exposures, same fights.

threats: Chain-CC risk (1 hard-CC abilities, ~1.0s of lockdown): Gadget Security Gate (root 1s). Don't group tight into it — stagger the engage and hold mobility/cleanse for the key one.
synergy: Our engage/CC: Lt. Belica Neural Disruptor (silence 0.5s). Our kills come from landing burst INSIDE that CC window — whoever lands it, the rest must follow up immediately.
Strong AoE/teamfight kit — group at choke points and fight on top of objectives.

skylar.loadout: Vermis (Serration + Melting Point), augment Assault MK-II , crest Liberator
lines: Lead story: Damage well above normal. 1,240 hero damage a minute, more than 87% of Skylar carry players this patch (33% of the team's). Penetration did the work: Steel took about 27% more physical damage than their armor allowed (estimate).
Skylar dealt 42,165 hero damage, 33% of their team's, with +242 physical power from items.

Penetration: Vanquisher 12, Demolisher ignores 25%; against Steel (level 16: about 252 physical armor, 177 after penetration; took 15,082 physical damage from heroes, 53% of all hero damage they took) and Rampage (level 17: about 154 physical armor, 103 after penetration; took 16,104 physical damage from heroes, 47% of all hero damage they took) that is about 27% and 25% more damage (estimate: percent penetration taken before flat).
Tainted Rounds (item): On Successful Basic Attacks: Reduce the Target's Healing by 45% for 3s. Deal (+10%) (+20%) Damage On-Hit. Increases by up to 100% as the Target's Health decreases.
Imperator (item): Critical Strikes deal 30% more damage.
Vermis (Eternal): Every 3rd consecutive Basic Attack on the same Enemy Hero within 2.5s deals 3% (+0.25% per Level) of their Max Health as bonus Physical Damage.
Serration (Eternal minor): Vermis also deals 3.5% of the target's Missing Health as bonus Physical Damage.
Melting Point (Eternal minor): Deal 10% bonus damage to targets with more than 125 Physical Armor.

Sustain: 7% lifesteal; Tainted Rounds: On Successful Basic Attacks: Reduce the Target's Healing by 45% for 3s. Deal (+10%) (+20%) Damage On-Hit. Increases by up to 100% as the Target's Health decreases.; Liberator: Cleanse all Debuffs. Gain a 80 (+100%) Shield for 2.5s.; 3,182 healing recorded.

Lesson: Skylar's penetration cut through: Steel took about 27% more physical damage than their armor alone allows (estimate: at level 16 their armor was about 252, about 177 after 12 flat + 25% penetration).
Stack (Every basic attack set off): 4 effects on one trigger: Plasma Blade, Tainted Rounds, Demolisher, Vermis.
Stack (Healing off the damage): 2 effects on one trigger: Tainted Rounds, Liberator.
The Eternal was part of it: Vermis (Serration + Melting Point) sits on the same trigger as the items (every basic attack set off), so the same hits paid out twice.
Countered? 3 of the 5 players Skylar killed built physical armor (Steel, Rampage, Shinbi). No anti-heal on the team against a build that heals. We killed Skylar 5 times.

Copy it? Vermis (Serration + Melting Point): 44.4% in 919 Skylar carry games, below the hero's 47.1%; this 3-item core: 50.9% in 281 games, level with the 50.2% of that hero-role's cores. It wins less than usual elsewhere: it beat us, not the field.

lt-belica.loadout: Thraex (Savage Strikes + Ferocity), augment Pulsefire Rounds, crest Typhoon
lines: Lead story: Damage well above normal. 1,608 hero damage a minute, more than 98% of Lt. Belica mid players this patch (42% of the team's). The damage came from Prophecy, Nuclear Rounds, Orion.
Neural Disruptor at rank 3: 85s base, about 50.6s by the end (40% shorter) from 68 ability haste: Prophecy 15, Spectra 10, Nuclear Rounds 20, Orion 15, Typhoon 8.
Lt. Belica dealt 54,679 hero damage, 42% of their team's, with +185 magical power from items.
Prophecy (item): On Basic Attacks: Deal 20 (+15%) Damage On-Hit.
Nuclear Rounds (item): Based on Critical Strike Chance: Increase Ability Damage by 10-20%.
Orion (item): Upon successful On-Hit Attack: Deal 2% increased damage to the Target for 3.5s, up to a maximum of 16%.
Scattershot (item): Upon successful On-Hit Attack: Summon 2 projectiles from the Target. These home towards the closest Enemies. Each deals (+40%) Damage. Applies On-Hit effects at 50% effectiveness.

Thraex (Eternal): Mark the last Enemy Hero damaged by your Basic Attack for 3s, increasing your damage against them by 3% (+0.4% per level) and reducing the damage they deal to you by 1.5% (+0.35% per level).
Pulsefire Rounds (augment): Lt. Belica's Basic Attacks also deal (+10%)(+12%) Damage On-Hit.

Sustain: Savage Strikes: Deal 1.5 (+0.4 per level) Physical Damage On-Hit. Attacking an Enemy Hero increases this by 100% for 3s, stacking up to 3 times. Heal for the damage dealt.; 7,598 healing recorded.
Toughness: +100 health; took 32,624 damage, mitigated 17,447, died 5 times.
Stack (Every basic attack set off): 8 effects on one trigger: Prophecy, Spectra, Orion, Scattershot, Typhoon, Thraex, Savage Strikes, Pulsefire Rounds.
The Eternal was part of it: Thraex (Savage Strikes + Ferocity) sits on the same trigger as the items (every basic attack set off), so the same hits paid out twice.
Countered? 1 of the 4 players Lt. Belica killed built magical armor (Terra). Anti-heal on Gadget, Skylar, Aurora. We killed Lt. Belica 5 times.
Copy it? Thraex: 45.6% in 114 Lt. Belica midlane games, below the hero's 51.6%. It wins less than usual elsewhere: it beat us, not the field.

card.lesson: Neural Disruptor came back about every 51s instead of 85s by the end (40% shorter). Count it, and take fights while it is down.

effects.how: Deal 1.5 (+0.4 per level) Physical Damage On-Hit. Attacking an Enemy Hero increases this by 100% for 3s, stacking up to 3 times. Heal for the damage dealt.

lead.title: Damage well above normal
lead.text: 1,608 hero damage a minute, more than 98% of Lt. Belica mid players this patch (42% of the team's). The damage came from Prophecy, Nuclear Rounds, Orion.

stacks.title: Every basic attack set off

members.name: Prophecy
members.text: On Basic Attacks: Deal 20 (+15%) Damage On-Hit.

members.name: Spectra
members.text: On Basic Attacks: Deal 20 Damage On-Hit. Reduces the Cooldown of Prisma by 3s. Applies a stack of Prism to Heroes & Monsters for 2.5s, stacking up to 3 times. If the Target has 3 Prism stacks on them, trigger Prisma.

members.name: Orion
members.text: Upon successful On-Hit Attack: Deal 2% increased damage to the Target for 3.5s, up to a maximum of 16%.

members.name: Scattershot
members.text: Upon successful On-Hit Attack: Summon 2 projectiles from the Target. These home towards the closest Enemies. Each deals (+40%) Damage. Applies On-Hit effects at 50% effectiveness. Can Critically Strike and deals 1.5x damage to Minions.

members.name: Typhoon
members.text: On Successful Basic Attacks: Gain a stack of Cyclone On-Hit for 3s. Each stack increases your Attack Speed by 3 (+3%)%. Stacks up to 4 times.

members.name: Thraex
members.text: Mark the last Enemy Hero damaged by your Basic Attack for 3s, increasing your damage against them by 3% (+0.4% per level) and reducing the damage they deal to you by 1.5% (+0.35% per level).

members.name: Savage Strikes
members.text: Deal 1.5 (+0.4 per level) Physical Damage On-Hit. Attacking an Enemy Hero increases this by 100% for 3s, stacking up to 3 times. Heal for the damage dealt.

members.name: Pulsefire Rounds
members.text: Lt. Belica's Basic Attacks also deal (+10%)(+12%) Damage On-Hit.

stacks.text: 8 effects on one trigger: Prophecy, Spectra, Orion, Scattershot, Typhoon, Thraex, Savage Strikes, Pulsefire Rounds.

worked.eternalPart: The Eternal was part of it: Thraex (Savage Strikes + Ferocity) sits on the same trigger as the items (every basic attack set off), so the same hits paid out twice.

countered.text: 1 of the 4 players Lt. Belica killed built magical armor (Terra).

copy.text: Thraex: 45.6% in 114 Lt. Belica midlane games, below the hero's 51.6%. It wins less than usual elsewhere: it beat us, not the field.
